results.evidence: All 8 tests in tests/test_review_lead_export_branches.py pass (8 passed). I did not run mutation probes, so 'would fail if broken' rests on reading the assertions against cottonwood/review.py. (1) The deleted and empty-email parametrized cases each assert draftable is False and blocked_by == ['no_contact_email']. These match the `not row['email_norm'] or row['deleted_at'] is not None` branch in _export_contact. (2) The test writes a direct_candidate checklist into the config and stores an answer for only one item. It asserts the unanswered item is 'unknown'. (3) The invalid-JSON, JSON-object and JSON-string cases all assert verified_facts == [], which covers the JSONDecodeError and non-list branches of _facts. (4) The test inserts an older and a newer evidence row. It asserts observed_at order is newest first and checks the published_at values and the newest row's url, which covers ORDER BY observed_at DESC and the published_at field. (5) The organization test asserts the exact dict {name: 'Firm (TEST)', domain: 'firm.example.com'}. Each assertion would fail if its branch regressed.
